title: valxel.events v1
description: A product-event summary line's JSON, after the `valxel.events ` marker: each event a component recorded since its last line, and how many times. The Valxel SDLC (outcomes/instrumentation.py) sums these to prove a feature's events fire and to measure its goal. Counts and event names only, never people. The Valxel SDLC owns this file (agentic-sdlc standard_files/contracts) and keeps every repo's copy at contracts/events/ in step with it; a change a producer could fail is v2.
